sloka: यन् मे धनम् च रत्नम् च ददौ राजा परम् तपः ।परिश्रान्तम् पथि अभवत् ततः अहम् पूर्वम् आगतः ॥२-७२-९॥
transliteration: yan me dhanam ca ratnam ca dadau rājā param tapaḥ ।pariśrāntam pathi abhavat tataḥ aham pūrvam āgataḥ ॥2-72-9॥

translations.english: The (horses carrying) the wealth including the gems which the king (of Kekaya), the subduer of enemies had bestowed on me were exhausted on the way. Therefore I have come in advance.
